quest.title: Where Does the Moon Hide?
quest.description: Columbina seems to be playing with kuuhenki in the Silvermoon Hall...

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: ...Hah.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: They seem to be having fun.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Greetings.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Greetings to you too, Luonnotar.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Playing a new game?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Yes. I saw people playing with their friends using cups at The Flagship, so I borrowed the idea.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: They would place a gemstone under a cup, then quickly shuffle the cups atop the table.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Upon stopping, they would have the other player guess which cup the gem was under.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: The kuuhenki love the feeling of spinning about while wrapped up in cloth, so I used Miss Mage's hat as a reference and made some improvements.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's adorable.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait. So you went to The Flagship... did anyone recognize you?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Some did ask, and I said, "I'm dressing up as the Moon Goddess today. I look just like her, don't I?"

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, you've really taken that trick from Moon-Prayer Night and ran with it...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And they believed you?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Well... Not entirely, but they didn't talk to me afterward either.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Was my acting not natural? I'll keep practicing somewhere else next time.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why does it feel like someone learned all the wrong lessons...

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Luonnotar would like you to guess where she's hiding. Would you like to play a round?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm in!

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: In that case, please stake 100,000 Mora to start with. Those are The Flagship's rules, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, you definitely should've skipped that lesson!

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Luonnotar says that she is very happy, and that we should play again next time.

talks.objective: Play with Luonnotar and guess where it's hiding

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Was that too easy for you?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Should you come around to play again, I will try to shuffle the hats around faster.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's curious... How exactly did you play with them earlier?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You can't see anything if you don't use kuuvahki, but if you do use it, you'll see too clearly...

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Well, I can open my eyes, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh yeah. Didn't think of that one...

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Ah, a shame. Better luck next time, I suppose.
